entries.note: Progress-bar group: the shipment is announced.
Progress-bar group: national routing.
Progress-bar group: arrived at the delivery office.
Progress-bar group: on the delivery round.
Progress-bar group: waiting at a pickup point; the stage is set from the group directly.
Progress-bar group: delivered to the letterbox.
Progress-bar group: delivered to the addressee.
Progress-bar group: delivery completed.
Progress-bar group: returning to the sender; the stage is set from the group directly.

entries.wording: incident / anomalie / avarie / endommagé / refusé / adresse incorrecte / adresse de livraison est incomplète
entries.note: Wording rule in eventStage, checked before the status collapse. Reclassified to exception 2026-09-12.
Event code; outranks the group. Incident wording still overrides it.
Event code: taken in charge. The only code with its own accepted stage.
Event code: in transit.
Event code: in transit.
Event code: out for delivery.
Event code: delivered.
Event code: the parcel waits at its pickup point. Seen under the groups DISMAD, DISINS and DISTOU and without a group for Chronopost, with three different sentences, so the code outranks the group.
Event code: entry into customs (group AARIDOU). The result status stays in_transit; DO2 (group AARENDDOU) is the release and stays in_transit.
Group: delivery failed; the result status becomes exception. Seen with code MD3.

entries.wording: vous attend dans votre point de retrait
entries.note: Resolved by the shared classifier. The sentence also arrives under the delivery-round group, which used to make the parcel out for delivery.

entries.wording: nous n'avons pu vous remettre votre colis
entries.note: Resolved by the shared classifier before the pickup wording: the sentence goes on to name the pickup point the parcel is sent to.

entries.wording: les formalites import/export sont en cours
entries.note: Resolved by the shared classifier; "sont terminees" is the release and stays in_transit.

entries.wording: Votre colis est sur son site de distribution. Nous le préparons pour le mettre en livraison.
entries.note: DISTOU/MD1, the sort into the morning's round: every live history shows the delivery or a failed attempt the same day, with no scan between.

entries.wording: Votre envoi est sur son site de distribution. Nous le préparons pour le mettre en livraison.
entries.note: The tracked-letter wording of the same DISTOU/MD1 scan.

Event code: the item could not be delivered that day and goes back out as soon as possible. Parcels word it as a future delivery round, so the code decides; the result status becomes exception. Seen under the groups DISIRST and DISAADR; the incomplete-address sentence of DISAADR is an exception.
Event code: customs release (groups AARENDDOU, AARNOTAXDOU and AARTAXDOU). The AARTAXDOU sentence announces delivery against duties and is not a new announcement.
Event code: duties paid. Under the group AARPAY they are paid online before delivery.
Group: duties paid at the door, scanned with code DO4 right after the delivery scan, so it does not reopen customs.
Event code: the item is being sent back to its sender (incorrect address, pickup deadline passed or non-compliant import documents); the result status becomes exception.
Event code: delivered back to the sender after a return (groups DESLREXP and DESMDREXP).
Event code: deposited with La Poste's partner in the origin country (group EDRINT).
Event code: ready to leave the origin territory (group ACHORI).
Event code: arrived in or moving through the destination territory (groups DISINTAS and ACHFR).
Event code: the recipient chose delivery to a postal point (group DISILIEU).
Event code: delivery attempted and a notice left (groups DISIECHEC, DISIPPREZ and DISIECIN).
Event code: the pickup point could not receive the parcel that day (group DISIKO).
Event code: import formalities suspended for a missing invoice (group AARIDISJ).
Event code: proof of posting or content issued to the sender (groups EDRPOC and COUREC); it does not move the parcel.
